newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London end volatile day up.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London end volatile day up.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks traded in London ended marginally higher on Wednesday after a roller-coaster session which saw shares tracking the London and New York stock markets, traders said.
The Hang Seng London Reference index closed 3.76 points higher at 11,240.12. Earlier in Hong Kong, the Hang Seng index ended 12.74 points up at 11,236.36.
Brokers said shares drifted higher in morning trade, following the London stock exchange and HSBC Holdings higher.
But shares lost their shine in afternoon trading after New York opened, and plunged lower in tandem with Wall Street.

"Just before Wall Street opened, Motorola's warning about their third quarter earnings came out taking the U.S. long bond from 7.11 to around 7.15. The street came off, bringing Hong Kong shares down," said one trader. By 1530 GMT, the Dow Jones industrial index had clawed back losses to stand 1.11 points up at 5728.29.
Brokers said they expected shares to trade cautiously this week ahead of U.S. data on Friday on consumer prices and retail sales.
